We're Hiring | AI Engineer | VLink

Join VLink and be part of an exciting opportunity to build cutting-edge Generative AI solutions, enterprise AI infrastructure, and intelligent automation.

Location: Gurgaon (Work From Office)
Experience: 46 Years
Shift Timing: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM
Working Days: 5 Days
Interview Mode: Virtual
Priority: High




Key Responsibilities

Build AI-powered applications using Advanced Java
Develop AI infrastructure, tooling, and workflow automation
Design and implement AI Chatbots using LLMs
Build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines
Work with LangChain, OpenAI APIs, MCP (Model Context Protocol), and Vector Databases
Deploy and maintain Java-based AI applications in production




Required Skills

Advanced Java (Java Deployment experience is mandatory)
Large Language Models (LLMs)
Generative AI
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
LangChain
OpenAI APIs
Vector Databases
AI Chatbot Development
Automation & Scripting
AI Infrastructure Development
